**Task model:** A shift lead scans all three routes, selects one to inspect, then changes the day-type cohort to check whether the pattern persists. Rates, previous-period comparisons and cancellations stay together; the selected route is retained when the cohort changes. Repeated desktop use favors aligned rows, while phone layouts keep all three routes together above the detail panel.

**Creative direction:** A harbor operations ledger: warm chart-paper surfaces, deep navy inspection panel, teal current-period bars and rust-colored declines. Shared 0–100% scales preserve magnitude; exact values carry smaller differences.
